notes:
User is getting more into yoga and follows Adriene on YouTube; they wanted apps with greater variety (Down Dog, YogaGlo, Alo Moves, Pocket Yoga, Yoga Studio, Daily Yoga, Omstars, Gaia were suggested). They use a Fitbit Charge 3 for health tracking, now for 9 months, including steps and potentially sleep data. They are replacing a long-used yoga mat and prioritize affordability, quality, eco-friendliness, cushioning, and joint support. Due to ongoing knee issues, they chose the thicker Hugger Mugger ParaMat (about 5 mm), despite it being heavier than lighter options such as the Manduka eKO SuperLite. Extra padding should be used cautiously; painful poses should be modified or avoided, and persistent knee pain warrants assessment by a qualified healthcare professional. They considered a yoga strap for alignment and accessible pose modifications, but have not said they will buy one.

User has recently been working on sleep quality. They have already established a consistent bedtime routine and a sleep-conducive environment, and now want to reduce stimulating evening activities, especially watching TV. They plan to replace TV with non-fiction reading, especially health and wellness topics such as nutrition, fitness, and mindfulness. Dan Harris’s *10% Happier* resonated with them, and a book about intermittent fasting inspired them to try it and observe its effects on energy and health.

They use a portable massage roller for workout recovery, stress relief, and muscle tension. They plan to use it before reading, especially on tense neck and shoulders from screen use. Guidance emphasized slow, gentle pressure, long strokes, breathing, and avoiding excessive trigger-point pressure or rolling the neck/front/side of the neck unsafely; stop if pain, numbness, or dizziness occurs. They enjoy non-fiction because it both calms them and inspires healthier habits.

They asked for healthy, easy, portable snack ideas. Suggestions included trail mix, fruit, energy balls, hard-boiled eggs, Greek yogurt, vegetables with hummus, smoothies, apple with almond butter, edamame, and moderate dark chocolate.
